_comment: Org Actions policy as code — the allow-listed third-party actions the org standard REQUIRES. This is the fourth org-setting conformance manages as version-controlled JSON (alongside rulesets/*.json): GitHub's 'Allow select actions' allowlist (Settings → Actions → General). scripts/apply-actions-policy.sh UNIONS `requiredPatterns` into the org's live allowlist — it never removes a pattern it doesn't know about, and never changes the allowed_actions mode — so applying it can only widen the allowlist, never break a repo's CI. github-owned + verified-creator actions are left as the org has them.
_requiredPatternsNote: Third-party actions referenced by bounded-systems/.github's repo-standard.yml that are NOT github-owned or verified-creator. INERT TODAY: the org is on allowed_actions:all, so there's no allowlist and this enforces nothing. It's groundwork for the enforcement epic (conformance#7) — if/when the org tightens to 'select actions', these are the required patterns. NOTE: this is NOT the fix for the .github#55 spell-gate startup_failure; that was a permission-escalation bug in repo-standard.yml (sbom/scorecard jobs request more than a contents:read caller grants), unrelated to the allowlist. Add a pattern here (a reviewed diff — that's the gate) when the org standard adopts a new third-party action; use `owner/repo@*` for any version. Keep sorted.
